Prices for the stay of Nov 5 to 7, 2026, as listed on October 1, 2026.

18 Strasbourg hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 1, 2026 for Nov 5 to Nov 7, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Strasbourg hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 18 Strasbourg hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Amimir.com at 1, Billabook.com at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, Michelin Guide Hotels at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and 3 other sites at 3 between them. These are the Strasbourg rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 17 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 8, Etrip.net at 2, Vio.com at 2, Amimir.com at 1, Billabook.com at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, Catchit.com at 1, dealbase.com at 1 and 6 other sites at 6 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 1, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Strasbourg hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($19 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Pavillon Régent Petite France to 18% at OKKO Hotels Strasbourg Centre. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
